node.title: Circuits are non-generic: the two-identity syzygy kernel vanishes off a determinantal locus
node.statement: The proved circuit lemma (#185) says a dependency = TWO simultaneous zero-polynomial identities. By degree counting, the simultaneous-syzygy kernel is generically zero; full-support minimal circuits exist only on an EXPLICIT determinantal locus of configurations (the two kernels intersecting in exactly dimension 1). Circuits are exceptional by construction, not just empirically.
